title: Studs moved by framing auto-joins

context.tool_or_bridge: MCP server with a C# execution tool

intent: Frame a wall panel with 2x6 studs at 16in o.c. between a bottom plate and a double top plate.
use_when: placing studs or posts as structural framing between plates

iterations.instruction: Placed studs as Brace, disallowed joins only on the plates
iterations.problem: Stud lengths 3 in too long in the cut list

iterations.instruction: Followed ARPL-ASM-0004: disallowed joins on every member at creation, reset the location curve

final_rule.lesson: Same behaviour in Revit 2025 as recorded for 2024.
final_rule.validation: Cut-list lengths compared with the layout; interference check

notes: This is a reproduction: it confirms ARPL-ASM-0004 in Revit 2025.
